species: human (SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cell line, retinoic-acid differentiated)
readout_other: Fluo-8 AM calcium imaging; Eu-TTA thermal imaging; gentamicin ion-channel block
direction_notes: Calcium transients rose significantly at 0.05 and 0.3 W/cm2 but not at 0.013 W/cm2; one-sided (electrode-free) chips and gentamicin abolished the response.
safety_notes: No metal delamination or damage to the chip and no immediately notable morphological change in cells after exposure; a 1.2 W/cm2 exposure raised temperature by 0.03 C.

exposures.label: 1.47 GHz AlN chip-scale transducer, continuous wave, 20 s, SH-SY5Y cells

target.label: SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells differentiated with retinoic acid to a more neural phenotype

device.model: piezoelectric AlN thin-film transducers fabricated on double-polished silicon wafers

timing.protocol_description: Single 20 s continuous-wave exposure per recording: at least 10 s without stimulus, 20 s of ultrasound, then post-stimulus recording (about 50 s). Intensities of 0.013, 0.05 and 0.3 W/cm2 (range recorded as 0.013-0.3). Drive 2 V, 5 V (and 10 V for a thermal control at 1.2 W/cm2). A second exposure after a 120 s recovery was used in a recovery experiment.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The 2µm AlN layer with a 2µm oxide layer between the 725µm silicon and AlN results in a thickness-mode resonance at 1.47 GHz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: Gentamicin data corresponds to sample exposed to ion-channe blocking at $0 . 3 \frac { W } { { c m } ^ { 2 } } . 0 . 0 1 3 , 0 . 0 5 , 0 . 3 \frac { W ^ { e m } } { { c m } ^ { 2 } }$ correspond to intensities applied to double sided devices.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: One 20 s stimulus was delivered to the cells during recordings, a longer than usual stimulus time than several other studies to increase delivered energy and match the time scale of calcium ionic transients in order to capture more transients during stimulus.

flags.reason: Intensities are the paper's estimate "in water" derived from interferometer displacement measured in air at the silicon-air interface; the metric (peak vs average) is not named and the authors say actual intensity at the cells is lower.
Only trial and ROI counts are given (three repeated trials per intensity); no count of cultures or samples stated.
Higher 1.2 W/cm2 exposure was used only for thermal imaging, not for the stimulation experiments.
